### Description

**Summary:**
When running `bunx skills add kreuzberg-dev/kreuzberg` (or similar add commands via Vercel's open agent skills tool, vercel-labs/skills), the tool attempts to fetch a GitHub authentication token by directly invoking `gh auth token` using Node.js's execSync.

## Problem

Currently, `npx skills update` only works for skills installed from GitHub.com repositories. The update logic explicitly skips non-GitHub sources:

// Only check GitHub-sourced skills with folder hash

}
```

This means users who host their skills in:
- Azure DevOps
- Bitbucket
- GitLab self-hosted
- Other git hosting services

...cannot use the update functionality. They must manually remove and reinstall skills to get updates.

items.title: Feature request: Support updates for non-GitHub repositories (Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, GitLab self-hosted)
